description:
Tawadoo: Buy, Sell & Bid — Morocco's #1 Free Marketplace 🇲🇦

Experience the future of smart shopping with Tawadoo — the ultimate free marketplace to buy, sell, and bid in Morocco. From Casablanca and Rabat to Marrakech, Agadir, Fès, and Tangier, discover thousands of local listings near you. 🎯

Looking for a smarter way to shop or sell? Tawadoo puts the thrill of live auctions and the power of direct negotiation right at your fingertips — whether you're decluttering your home or hunting for that perfect find.

Why Tawadoo?
More than a classifieds app — Tawadoo is an integrated platform that combines the proximity of local markets with competitive auctions and an immersive, social experience built on photos and videos, ensuring transparency and trust in every transaction. 💡

Key Features:
✅ AI-Powered Listings — Our AI automatically generates compelling titles and descriptions to maximise your visibility and search ranking. 🤖
✅ Auto-Translation — Post in French or Arabic; Tawadoo translates your listing into the buyer's language for a seamless experience. 🌍
✅ Photos & Video — HD photos and short videos so buyers see your items from every angle. 📸
✅ 3 Ways to Sell — Fixed price, negotiated offers, or live auctions with real-time bidding. 🤝
✅ Analytics Dashboard — Track listing performance, views, and sales stats in real-time. 📈
✅ Precise Geolocation — Find and sell right in your neighbourhood, from Casablanca to Agadir. 📍
✅ Verified Profiles & Secure Messaging — A trusted community with privacy-first chat. 🔒

Browse Categories:
🔹 Real Estate: Apartments, houses, offices
🔹 Motors: Cars, motorcycles, spare parts
🔹 High-Tech: Smartphones, laptops, electronics
🔹 Fashion: Clothing, jewellery, accessories
🔹 Home & Garden: Furniture, décor, DIY
🔹 Services & Jobs: Job offers and professional services
🔹 Pets: Everything for your companions

Tawadoo Coins: Win & Save! 💰
Boost your experience with Tawadoo Coins. Earn by playing the Daily Lucky Wheel, rating your partners, or referring friends. Buy Coins directly in-app for an instant boost. Use them to feature listings, join auctions as a security deposit, or extend your publication limits.

Security & Compliance 🛡️
Your safety is our top priority. Compliant with Law 09-08 — you have the right to access, rectify, and object to the processing of your data. Authorised by the CNDP under N°A-W-1438/2025.
🔹 Verified Profiles · Secure Messaging · Your data is never sold.

How It Works:
1️⃣ Browse — Explore thousands of local listings across Morocco.
2️⃣ Connect — Chat directly with sellers via secure messaging.
3️⃣ Close — Negotiate and finalise your deal with ease.

Ask Tawadoo on ChatGPT to search Morocco's marketplace, find local deals, and discover listings near you — instantly. 🚀

defaultPrompt: Je cherche un smartphone pour moins de 15 000 DH
Trouve moi des berlines allemandes autour de 850 000 DH
Trouve moi une villa à louer à Marrakech pour l’été en famille
